name: prefab-create
description: Creates or overwrites a prefab asset from one scene or prefab-stage GameObject. By default only the asset is saved; set connectGameObjectToPrefab=true to keep the source scene object linked as a prefab instance.

sourcePath.description: Scene or prefab-stage GameObject path to save as a prefab.

sourceInstanceId.description: Scene or prefab-stage GameObject instance id to save as a prefab.

prefabPath.description: Project asset path for the prefab, e.g. Assets/Prefabs/Foo.prefab.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing prefab asset at prefabPath.

connectGameObjectToPrefab.description: When true, use Unity SaveAsPrefabAssetAndConnect so the source scene object becomes/keeps a connected prefab instance. Default false saves the asset only and leaves the source object disconnected.
